apps.name: YouPro
apps.subtitle: Feature-rich YouTube tweak by alibusut
apps.localizedDescription: YouPro is an advanced YouTube modification tweak developed by alibusut. It features background playback, ad-free streaming, inline download capabilities, OLED true dark theme, SponsorBlock, and enhanced media playback controls.
apps.versionDescription:
YouTube 21.39.4 | YouProExtra_21.39.4_1.3.1

### Latest Release, ENJOY!!
> [!NOTE]
> - **YTUHD** is not included. 4K60HDR is available.
> - if you're signed out you can sign in manually. 
> - no iSponsorBlock. (unstable in newer builds)
> - for <A15 devices press share button in the arrow down panel and use external player for AV1 videos.
> - - -
> #### Extra Tweaks:
> - `YouPip` `YouSlider` `YTweaks` `YouSpeed` `YouMute` `YouLoop` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality`  `YouGetCaption` 
> -  `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `Gonerino` 

> [!WARNING]
> - 21.34.3+ builds require iOS 17+ now.

compatibility.notes: YouPro is developed by alibusut (distributed via the developer's Telegram). This source serves a ready-to-sideload IPA built from the official YouPro tweak by mrdrvt99/YouProEXTRA. Shares com.google.ios.youtube with the other YouTube mods: install one at a time.
